thread:
Raj V: Heads-up: planning a tenant_metadata schema migration + backfill in tonight's 23:00 UTC change window. ~120M rows; using staged shards. Need deploybot timing, pause points, and rollback plan. Anyone see blockers?
Anna M: Ack. What's the shard plan and throttle?
Raj V: 10 shard buckets, run sequential waves of 2 concurrent backfill workers, target ~30 r/s per worker. Index builds will be separate, offline.
Priya S: FYI earlier test on a 20M slice: ~18s per 1k rows with current CPU profile. At 30 r/s we should stay under p99 DB CPU thresholds. Recommend KV-prefix cache for hottest tenants.
Kyle H: Escape hatch: if replica lag or lock waits spike, do we pause or kill? What's immediate action?
Raj V: Immediate: trigger deploybot pause -> kill offending backfill job(s) -> flip FF to read-old-schema. If DB still unhealthy, revert schema change (rollback to v3.1.6).
DeployBot: scheduled: migration-job-runner start=2024-07-18T23:00:00Z shards=10 concurrency=2 rate=30r/s. holdpoint after shard 3. Reaction: :white_check_mark: (automated)
SRE-Lead: Add automated triggers to runbook: replica_lag >5s for >60s, lock_waits >50/min, db_cpu >85%. If fired, DeployBot should auto-pause and @channel. Also require manual resume after holdpoint.
Raj V: Agreed. I'll add those thresholds. Also adding manual approval after 3 shards to evaluate metrics and decide continue/rollback.
Anna M: Canary start command for shards 0..1:
```
deploybot run --plan tenant-metadata --shards 0..1 --rate 30 --concurrency 2
```
Pause command: `deploybot pause --plan tenant-metadata`
Priya S: I'll push a Grafana panel for per-shard throughput, replica lag, and backfill queue depth. ETA 40m. Will also add a short alert route to oncall+product.
Kyle H: Who owns postmortem if aborted?
Raj V: Feature team owns initial RCA (Priya), SRE owns infra follow-up (SRE-Lead). We'll note owners in runbook.
OpsBot: Release notes stub created: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/2148009999 includes rollback steps and owner contacts.
SRE-Lead: Also request a staging dry-run at 20:30 UTC with identical throttles to validate pause/kill and FF flip path. Can't skip the dry-run.
Raj V: Dry-run scheduled 20:30 UTC in staging. I'll paste dry-run logs here and keep this thread for run logs only. Please ack if you can watch.
Anna M: I'll watch dry-run. :eyes: 
Priya S: On-call for prod run.
Kyle H: Backup oncall.
DeployBot: holdpoint set after shard=3 complete. Await `deploybot resume` from Raj V or SRE-Lead to continue.
Anna M: Add `pg_terminate_backend(pid)` guidance to runbook with selector to target backfill worker pids only; avoid mass kills.
Raj V: Added. Pinning migration schema version: v3.1.7. Final checklist will be posted 30m before window.
Priya S: :thumbsup:
Kyle H: :white_check_mark:
